control_model.cycle_period: signed Pauli-conjugation period T_pm, not phase-quotiented frame order

zeroth_order: existing cycle average Hbar0=(1/T) sum_j H_j

second_order.single_basis_metric: Hilbert-Schmidt coefficient norm squared for each normalized Pauli basis Hamiltonian
second_order.two_term_metric: same norm for H=(P+Q)/sqrt(2), exhaustively over unordered pairs of the 276 basis terms

finite_cycle_diagnostic.dimensionless_dwell: eta=tau times input Hamiltonian coefficient scale
finite_cycle_diagnostic.crossover: smallest positive eta at which this diagnostic reaches the static-I zeroth-order RMS of 1

loss_exposure_repair: physical exposure for a coherent averaging cycle is per-step primitive cost times signed period T_pm
scope: zeroth plus first Magnus correction only; finite pulse widths, higher Magnus orders and hardware calibration excluded
